`primary_mode` (hybrid = the pinned embedder + FTS5 + the pinned reranker, the mode
`recall` runs by default) carries the bar; every other mode in `modes` is measured
that every anchor and origin here matches seed/seed_pack.json -- a pack change that
moves an entry fails it until this file is re-keyed.
